title: The Figure Goes Up the Road

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The tenth day reads what the ninth would not. The reader goes up the road with the box shut, and the wool lies where it lay. Three readings are three and not one account.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the rack end in Low Kiln, told in the last tend of Smoke

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and sixty-seven to two hundred and sixty-nine days, six months and eighty-seven to six months and eighty-nine days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing — the file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; the body inventoried as a wound of crust, gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop in the order they arrive; the third reading taken apart as a chart read over a covered body that cannot answer; the hand's answerings kept as honest objects and never promoted into a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power or a rule — with no present-tense Chicago break and no tagged remembered line; the old life stays offstage, and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room or back-room interior, no sixth hearing, no tenth stopping before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, no sixth asking and no witness for the row question (the five askings and the one further shaping stand as they stood), no tenth record-first hand, no eighth of the green or the shape, no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause, no name spoken over either sighting, no loaf, slate or sale, no calling of the loan, no naming of a payer, no private record opened, read or copied, no figure given for the covered grain or for the hand that did not come back, no silt-leach or cure named for the cold foot carried below the sill, no lesson made of the one opening before Smoke 1, no fourth reading brought early, and no ending.

scenes.title: The Eighty-Seventh Day
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and the first \daymark{267}{...} (Smoke 28, Eighthday, Y.H. 813). Open in the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof with the hand laid down against the fold on the one hundred and eighth answer; set it down as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking, never recalled as a sign, growth, reaching, gift or power. No recap of Chapter 71; the reader has just read it. Carry the count from 266 to 267 exact, six months and eighty-seven days, told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-seven days, its payer unnamed (T088). Body inventory in the old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, gone past the point where a child would have eaten it, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread and a basket set down is a pot set down and left; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform. He knows the composed face that is not composure, knows a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse; he wants the crust lifted two inches. Both true, the second louder in a body of two hundred and sixty-seven days, entered nowhere (T060/T086). Three counts in three places, none rising into another: the kiln's four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand under the floor; the river's water over water through the finger's-width door; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands (T061/T082). Smoke 28 comes on its own morning, earned by that light, and was not brought into Day 266; no market, Cross or bell on an Eighthday; Smoke 30 (Day 269) stands two mornings ahead and is not brought early; the first firing of Frost (Day 271) is far off. Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, counts under her breath toward no opening (small intake, hold, letting go), pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak shows pale, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal tally stays unread, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing, moves her lips along a two-gapped row without giving either gap a figure, and sets the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T100). The dressed grain lies covered under wool on the cool stone at the rack end away from the hearth; she lifts a corner for damp and lays it back, changing nothing and gaining no figure, so that the arithmetic read over it on Smoke 30 still will not know what it cost and the space between figure and price stays unsigned (T077). Frost that wrote white on the well lip is gone and the yard calls the whole of it weather; he keeps whatever white was there on a place of its own with no cause, not a payer, not the widow's mark (a well is not an opening) and not the first firing of Frost (T083/T085). A cost-question at the door goes to the pot and the weather; a man come down the clay road brings a number up out of a fist toward the well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere and none is supplied (T015/T041/T047). The widow's mark hangs where it hangs, untouched since before the kiln on Smoke 1, because a morning, a hearth, a rack and a bed are not openings (T058/T079). Hand answer one hundred and nine: up an inch toward the low note, held for the small intake only, down on the river's next low note, borrowing no house count; the little silence after a count that ended in the room that does not touch is left empty again on its own place and not crossed (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Places Gone Around
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 267, no new dated heading: afternoon thinning into the small hours at the Clay Yard's walked-around places, the yard well and bare trough, the drying racks and the space beneath the lowest rack, the pan's gone ring, the terrace and worked strips, the kindling and flagstones, the edge of the Vail wheel-shed, the finger's-width-open back room as a direction and a sound only, the clay road at the going of the light, the bed and the towel. Afternoon thins without ending, the way heat goes out of a pot set off the coals; heat settles behind the pot and into the fold. One crust two inches off, gap unnamed, no third; thread frozen; cold at cheek, temple, wrist; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform (T061/T082). Garl is kept in objects and not in a story, his name unspoken two hundred and sixty-seven days: the salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, the hollow wheel-seat, the proverb gone years ago to a pot with no crack and said now over a corner where the repair was rubbed out, the uncalled tile debt circled without a name, neither paid nor settled nor done with. No collector came up the clay road on Smoke 28 and none went down it (T009/T013/T092). Sella carries the basket at the half-pace from every open slate and goes wide around seven things with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line, the finer grey hairline called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word, the bare dark trough with its water called weather, the field's empty place out on the worked strips, and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out. Seven in a row are seven and not an account, because an account wants a payer standing under it and none stands. That hand is carried and not named, not paid, not joined to the shelf's two gaps, the fold's one crust, the dressed grain or any other kept absence (T098 carried, T060/T086). Below the sill a child's foot that stayed cold after the flood is wrapped in a woman's wool and called the cold by her and weather by the yard; the boy keeps it as the extremity going before the core and the afterdrop waiting beyond, and names no cause, no silt-leach and no cure, because there is no Grathic word for it and nobody has asked for one (T093/T094 carried). A wrong wind off High Kiln brings the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touches the fold and goes out on the wind that brought it — a direction arrived nowhere, not a second edge paid, not joined to the man carried out on Day 188 (T064). At the kindling: Tarn takes the broom only after it is instructed, says Yes, house to an early thaw and a late, agreeing with both so no argument finds a foot and keeping the late because it puts off the paying, and tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count; the knife at the very lip with six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh where it cannot, Garl's unforged collector sentence beside it with no name on the man who turned back at the frozen ford and no figure on the debt. The ear-sentence about an ear under this roof being worth more than the debt that holds it comes to his teeth and goes as far as the word that would call the loan and stops there — a remembered ninth stopping, no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven; the Seed 16 breath unspent, chest tight, Ash worked into the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, the pale clip-ring at the left wrist, the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its unmarked loft pot, not tried and not forgiveness (T036/T076, T006). At the wheel-shed edge Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and white in the creases of a fist, parts dusty forearms from clean and asks neither which slate broke nor whether it was a birth-slate; men unnamed went low into the finger's-width-open back room before first grey and got no name and no word that the room was cold. He speaks to the wheel before any person (It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady), tells a pot You'll do, knows the full note it will give three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it, and withholds the knowing on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them. The burned-slate word stands at four from Slate Row, a direction and not a fifth telling; the two shut-room tellings stand at two; the three pot sayings stand with the premature Smoke 14 note on its own place and no fourth likeness made a cause; the five askings of the row question stand with the one further shaping beside them and no witness and no row named; the promise of the boy's name is neither given nor withdrawn and he's not Vail stays sealed. His bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, one piece of iron with two bites, mercy and mutilation, with no Grathic word for both, joined to no kiln (T035/T031, T062, T065/T095, T061/T082). Under the roof she sets him on the bed and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, leaves the thread frozen, tells the fire the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, counts under her breath toward no opening and goes to her own bed. In the small hours he turns the file out on the towel and finds it exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place; three near-full answers and three pot sayings on separate places; four low things with water over water a fifth; told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with Smoke's second arithmetic gone up the road in a locked box and unread; nine stoppings with no tenth; three held changes on three places, the loft scrape on a fourth, the pale line on a fifth and the held inch on a sixth with one hundred and nine answers; nine record-first hands with Ilva's ninth on its own tray and her strip unread in her sleeve; the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth; covered grain unfigured; pan's ring, shelf gaps and fold's crust on trays that do not touch; five askings with one shaping and no witness; house's not-doings on a place apart from his own gaps with a finger between and no joining (T080 held at nine, T101 held at five, T100). Hand answer one hundred and ten: one rhythm carried across the little silence after a count that ended in the room that does not touch, taken as an object in its own right, crossing no second count and filling nothing, down on the river's next low note.

scenes.title: The Twenty-Ninth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated \daymark{268}{...}: Day 268, Smoke 29, Ninthday, Y.H. 813, from the small hours under the Vail roof up the Clay Yard to the drying racks and the rack end and the yard well, and back at the going of the light. New day, new date, no recap. Smoke 29 comes on its own morning, earned by that light, and was not brought into Day 267; no market, Cross or bell; Smoke 30 (Day 269), the third and last Account-day and market of the second firing, stands one morning ahead and is not brought into a day that has not earned it; the first firing of Frost (Day 271) is far off. Carry 268 exact, six months and eighty-eight days, nobody told (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-eight days, its payer unnamed (T088); the widow's mark untouched since before the kiln on Smoke 1, because a rack, a well, a yard and a bed are not openings (T058/T079). First smells and sounds as before: hot clay under tallow, wet wool, the sour Ash breath of the unswept corner called the thaw; the kiln in fours with its gap, not a bell; the river low over lower. Sella's grammar holds exactly: fire before basket, thaw told to the coals, broken pot turning them, The house will keep it, half-pace from every open slate, finger above the charcoal, pot handle two inches out, fold put right without a look at his face, thread left frozen (T100). On the cool stone at the rack end the dressed grain is turned once under the wool for damp and laid back with a lighter touch, changed in state and given no figure; the arithmetic to be read over it in the morning will not know what it cost, and the space between the figure and its price stays unsigned (T077). At the yard well Ilva is glimpsed once drawing with the pail against her knee, clay pale in the crescents of her nails and grey rack dust in the seam of one thumb; her hand goes toward her sleeve and stays there, the notched birch strip is not taken out, read, asked about or joined to the reed-cutter's cord, the knots, the pages, the tins, the charcoal under the shelf or any other private keeping, and she answers the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account. She goes on with her water and nobody turns twice. No tenth record-first hand is filed; the ninth stays on its own tray with a finger between it and the eighth (T080 held at nine, not paid). A cost-question at the door goes to the pot and the weather; a man come down the clay road brings a number up out of a fist toward the well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere and none is supplied (T015/T041/T047, T077). Hand answer one hundred and eleven: up an inch toward the low note, held through one whole interval of the river's own going, down on the river's next low note, borrowing no house count and no stroke. An object on the sixth place, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air.

scenes.title: The Day Before the Reading
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry of Day 268, no new dated heading: afternoon thinning into the small hours at the walked-around places, the yard well, the boards, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the back room as a direction and a sound, the bed and the towel. Smoke goes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two names for the months is set right or left wrong. Heat drawings back from the fold into the pot; one crust two inches off with its gap unnamed and no third; thread frozen; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform (T061/T082). The seven walked-around places are gone around again with a look and a wide step and no number, including the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out — carried, not named, not paid, not joined (T009/T013/T092, T098). The ownerless row question is not asked a sixth time and gains no second shaping on this day: the five askings stand on the seventh place with the one further shaping beside them, a finger between each pair, no witness standing to be asked and no row named. The boy takes the silence of it as a keeping and not as a sixth witness, and makes no cause of it (T101 held, unpaid). At the kindling Tarn's knife lies at the very lip with six where the house can check and the seventh where it cannot, the unforged collector sentence beside it; the ear-sentence comes to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven; the Seed 16 breath is unspent, the loan uncalled, the stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot, and no collector comes up or goes down the clay road (T036/T076, T006, T009/T013/T092). At the wheel-shed edge Jorra's meal-fine dust, his bent finger standing in the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, the burned slate at four, the two shut-room tellings at two, the three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart and no fourth likeness, the promise ungiven and he's not Vail sealed go as before; the men in the back room are given no name (T035/T031, T062, T065/T095). In the small hours the file is turned out and checked and found exact, complete and worth nothing: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh; three near-full answers and three pot sayings on separate places; told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid; nine stoppings with no tenth; three held changes on three places plus the loft scrape, the pale line and the held inch on a sixth; nine record-first hands with the ninth on its own tray and the strip unread; the five askings with one shaping and no witness; the covered grain unfigured with the third reading one morning off; the house's not-doings kept beside his own gaps with a finger between and no joining (T080 held at nine, T101 held at five, T077, T100). Hand answer one hundred and twelve: up an inch for the small intake, held past the letting-go of a counted breath in the room that does not touch, and down on the river's next low note, taking the little silence after the house's count as an object on its own place but not crossing it and borrowing no stroke. An honest coordination, not a reach, hearing, seventh, payment or power (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Third Reading of Smoke
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated \daymark{269}{...}: Day 269, Smoke 30, Tenthday, Y.H. 813, the third and last Account-day and market of the second firing. New day, new date, no recap. Carry 269 exact, six months and eighty-nine days, nobody told (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-nine days, its payer unnamed (T088); the widow's mark hanging where it hangs, untouched at a shelf, well, rack, road, basket, yard, market, morning, afternoon, dusk and going of the light, because a market and a reading are not openings (T058/T079). Smoke 30 is earned by this morning's own light and was not brought into Day 268; there is no further market, Cross or bell in this chapter; the first firing of Frost (Day 271) stands far off and unbrought. Sella carries him to the Cross, sets the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lies and stands half a pace off through the reading and the bell, giving no instruction or reason to the basket and saying nothing at the going of the light when she carries him home. Eight pigs go over the wet boards and two hundred lean in. Berr Clay comes up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, under the hot clay of him the smell of nothing at all; his large clean hands wipe the thumb twice before touching nothing, pass a finger over the figure, hold a narrow slate unopened to the forearm, and read one in twelve, as the notice says low into the crowd, the figure going twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that came late. He says The levy is called. It is not called by me and your house, never I, and goes off toward High Kiln with the box locked and the third true subtraction inside, believing he has done a kindness (T015/T041/T047). The district's arithmetic changes for the third time in Smoke and cannot be changed back; the printed figure stands unchallenged, the figure read aloud is still not the figure paid, and the figure read over the dressed grain covered under wool at home does not know what it cost, the space between the two figures still unsigned (T077). The reading answers nothing for the man carried out on Day 188, the hand that went in on Seed 15, the covered grain or the row whose pot went quiet. Hessa Rale takes the narrow slate up the clay road toward Greybank before noon, edge-on and writing to her sleeve, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, answering the question put and not the one behind it with I don't read it. I carry it. There's a difference, and the road doesn't care which and Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I've got a road to walk; no figure comes off the slate and the eighth record-first hand stays on a place of its own, advanced and not paid (T080). The soft-cuffed Fishstairs clerk stays set below the north bridge at the out-of-line landing with his slate inward for a measure nobody called, and nobody takes him off (T090). The bell goes four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself; the heard bell is kept beside the told bell of the Long Night and the gap is not folded into the three counts under the roof or heard as a seventh of the full note (T078, T061/T082). Across the square at the pot board a silent woman's green stays a colour and at the market's edge a foundling's shape stays a shape, no eighth of either, no name, never Fenna or Ulda in the narration, no loaf, no slate and no sale (T050/T051, T033/T034 held). **The chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:** the boy registers that a figure read a third time over the same basket is no nearer to the covered thing it is read over — the arithmetic changes three times where two hundred people stand and goes home locked in a box, while the figure read is not the figure paid and the price of the grain stays unsigned; the not-knowing is as complete after the third reading as after the first, and three readings are three and not one account. He keeps it as a finding with no payer, not a lesson, grievance or doctrine, and does not lay it across the house's not-doings, the covered grain or his own kept gaps, for a joining would want a payer and none stands (T071/T072, T077, T015/T041/T047, T061/T082). Hand answer one hundred and thirteen: up an inch held for the small intake, down on the river's next low note while the bell goes in the square, the river's rhythm kept on its own place and not laid across the bell's four, four and a gap.

scenes.title: What the Third Reading Leaves
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 269, Smoke 30, afternoon into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the back room as a direction and a sound, the clay road at the going of the light, the bed, the boards and the towel. Smoke goes out without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two names for the months is set right or left wrong; Frost comes on in the dark beyond the door and is not brought into a day that has not earned it; the first firing of Frost (Day 271) is far off and unbrought. Afternoon thins without ending; heat draws back from the fold; one leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform (T061/T082). Garl is kept in objects, a keeping and not a story, his name unspoken two hundred and sixty-nine days, the tile debt neither paid nor settled nor done with, no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 28, 29 or 30 (T009/T013/T092). The seven walked-around places are gone around with a look and a wide step and no number, including the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out (T098 carried). Sella carries him up at the going of the light at the half-pace from every open slate, goes wide around the seven places, sets him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, leaves the thread frozen, tells the fire the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, counts under her breath toward no opening and goes to her own bed; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs, touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, yard, market, afternoon, dusk or going of the light on Smoke 28, 29 or 30, because a bed, a basket, a market and a dusk are not openings; the one opening before Smoke 1 stays behind the household with no lesson, sign, mending or payer named, and the next real opening stands far off in the first firing of Frost (T058/T079). At the kindling Tarn brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops, a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled, the stone cold in its loft pot and not trying not forgiveness (T036/T076, T006). At the wheel-shed edge Jorra's dust, his bent finger in the damper, the burned slate at four, the two shut-room tellings at two, the three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart and no fourth likeness, the row question at five askings with one shaping and still no witness and no row named, the promise ungiven and he's not Vail sealed go as before (T035/T031, T062, T065/T095, T101). In the small hours he turns the file out on the towel and finds the whole of it exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place; three near-full answers; three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note on its own place; four low things with water over water a fifth; told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with Smoke's third arithmetic gone up the road in a locked box and unread under this roof; nine stoppings with no tenth; three held changes on three places, the loft scrape on a fourth and the pale line of the carried man on a fifth, and the held inch on a sixth; nine record-first hands with Ilva's ninth on its own tray and her strip unread; the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth; the covered grain still unfigured with the figure read over it not knowing its cost and the space between unsigned; the pan's gone ring, the shelf's two gaps and the fold's one crust with its unnamed place on trays that do not touch; the row question at five askings with one shaping, no witness and no row named; and the finding that three readings are three and not one account kept on a place of its own with no payer, not laid across the house's not-doings or his own kept gaps (T080 held at nine, T101 held at five, T060/T086, T100, T077, T071/T072). Through the finger's-width door the river keeps its low note; under the floor the fire keeps four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have stood; over his head the boards keep four, four and a knot. No fire-sitter stands over the coals to supply a count and no house count is there to borrow; in the room that does not touch a count has ended and a little silence stands after it; in the square the bell's gap stands where the bell struck it and is not brought under the roof. Hand answer one hundred and fourteen: the hand goes up an inch toward the river's note, holds for the small intake, the hold and the letting-go of one of the breaths counted in the room that does not touch, does not come down with that breath, keeps the small height through the little silence after the count, and goes on past the river's note to the one after it — carrying two of the house's rhythms across the empty interval with no second house count borrowed and leaving the bell's gap in the square with a finger between, no stroke supplied to agree any three. It is one hundred and fourteen, filed on the sixth place beside one hundred and thirteen with no payer named, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air: an honest coordination and not a longer reach, a hearing, a seventh of the full note, a stopping, a payment, one of the held changes, a key, a power or a rule. He makes nothing of it and will not let it stand up as a gift. **269** stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath; six months and eighty-nine days are told by nobody; one hundred and eight answers became one hundred and fourteen and none is a reach; the carried fire stops at four with its fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-nine days and its payer unnamed; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs; the grain lies covered and unfigured with Smoke's third arithmetic gone up the road in a locked box; the heard bell stands beside the told and the figure read beside the paid; the seventh year stands at its very end and has still not given. Smoke goes out without a boundary drawn; Smoke 30 is lived and finished and Frost stands one morning ahead, not reached for; the first firing of Frost (Day 271) is far off and unbrought. The hand lies back against the fold as a tool put away; the file lies open on the towel with every tray parted and every gap left gap; the count goes forward into Frost 1, a day that has not earned its heading. Not mid-action; a placing-down, forward, unresolved. Nothing is opened, named, called, paid or ended.
